mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO source_record (source_file_id,record_type,business_key,sheet_name,source_row_no,raw_payload,record_fingerprint,validation_status) VALUES (#{sourceFileId},#{recordType},#{businessKey},#{sheetName},#{sourceRowNo},CAST(#{rawPayload} AS JSON),#{fingerprint},'VALID')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM source_record WHERE source_file_id=#{sourceFileId} AND record_type=#{recordType} AND business_key=#{businessKey} LIMIT 1
